userStoryName: Search flights by route and travel dates
userStoryDescription: As a traveler, I want to search flights using origin, destination, departure date, return date, and passenger count so that I can see eligible itineraries.
As a traveler, I want to filter by nonstop flights, cabin, departure time, and sort by price or duration so that I can narrow flight options.
As a traveler, I want each itinerary to show fare family benefits and restrictions so that I can compare baggage, change, and refund conditions.
As a customer, I want to save traveler identity and contact details so that I do not need to re-enter them for every booking.
As an international traveler, I want to securely maintain passport and travel-document details so that booking and check-in can validate required information.
As a traveler, I want to save wheelchair and assistance preferences so that eligible requests can be reused on future trips.
As a customer, I want my card payment authorized securely so that a valid booking can be created after successful payment.
As a customer, I want recoverable payment failures to be retried safely without duplicate charges so that checkout can complete reliably.
As a customer, I want a confirmation number and payment receipt after booking so that I have proof of purchase and itinerary details.
As a traveler, I want to see available and occupied seats on the aircraft so that I can select an eligible seat.
As a traveler, I want to purchase premium seat options with transparent pricing so that I can choose additional comfort.
As a traveler, I want to view available cabin upgrade offers so that I can upgrade my trip when inventory permits.
As a passenger, I want the system to determine whether I am eligible for online check-in so that restricted itineraries are handled correctly.
As a passenger, I want to confirm my details and check in for eligible flight segments so that I am marked ready for travel.
As a checked-in passenger, I want a digital boarding pass with flight, seat, boarding group, and barcode information so that I can board the aircraft.
As a traveler, I want to add and pay for checked bags before departure so that I can prepare for airport bag drop.
As a traveler, I want to see bag accepted, loaded, transferred, arrived, and carousel events so that I know the current status of my baggage.
As a traveler, I want notifications when my baggage is delayed or rerouted so that I can take appropriate action.
As a traveler, I want current departure, arrival, gate, delay, and cancellation status so that I can plan my airport journey.

userStoryName: Send gate and schedule change notifications
userStoryDescription: As a traveler, I want push, email, or SMS alerts when my gate or schedule changes so that I do not miss important updates.
As a customer, I want to choose notification channels and event types so that I receive only useful travel alerts.
As a traveler, I want the platform to detect cancellations, significant delays, and missed-connection risk so that recovery options can be offered.

userStoryName: Search alternate flights for disrupted customers
userStoryDescription: As a disrupted traveler, I want eligible alternate flights ranked by arrival time and connection quality so that I can recover my trip.
As a disrupted traveler, I want to confirm a replacement itinerary and receive updated travel documents so that I can continue my journey.

userStoryName: Calculate cancellation eligibility and refund amount
userStoryDescription: As a customer, I want cancellation rules and refundable amounts calculated from my fare so that I understand the financial impact before cancelling.

userStoryName: Initiate refund to original payment method
userStoryDescription: As a customer, I want eligible refunds returned to the original payment method so that cancelled travel is financially settled.

userStoryName: Track refund status and notify customer
userStoryDescription: As a customer, I want to see refund progress and receive completion notifications so that I know when money has been returned.

userStoryName: Link loyalty account to customer profile
userStoryDescription: As a loyalty member, I want to link my account to my traveler profile so that eligible travel activity is associated with my membership.

userStoryName: Earn loyalty points from completed travel
userStoryDescription: As a loyalty member, I want eligible points credited after travel so that my balance reflects completed flights.
As a loyalty member, I want to redeem available points for eligible bookings so that I can reduce the cash price of travel.

userStoryName: Create travel credit after eligible servicing event
userStoryDescription: As a customer, I want eligible unused value converted into a travel credit so that I can apply it to future travel.

userStoryName: Validate travel credit rules at checkout
userStoryDescription: As a customer, I want the platform to validate credit ownership, balance, expiration, and currency before applying it to a booking.
As the airline, I want voucher usage to be idempotent so that a voucher cannot be redeemed more than allowed.
As a traveler requiring mobility support, I want to request wheelchair assistance so that airport teams can prepare for my journey.
As an eligible traveler, I want to request a special meal so that my dietary preference is recorded for the flight.

userStoryName: Purchase priority boarding and lounge access
userStoryDescription: As a traveler, I want to purchase eligible airport ancillaries so that I can improve my pre-flight experience.
As a traveler, I want to search and book multiple flight legs across different cities so that complex trips can be purchased in one reservation.

userStoryName: Validate passport and international document data
userStoryDescription: As an international traveler, I want required document fields validated so that incomplete information is caught before travel.
As a traveler, I want destination-specific document and travel requirement information so that I can prepare for an international trip.
As a customer, I want to retrieve my reservation using confirmation and traveler details so that I can manage an existing trip.
As a customer, I want to update email and phone details on an eligible reservation so that operational notifications reach me.
As a customer, I want to change eligible flights and see any fare difference so that I can service my trip without calling support.
As a traveler, I want gate changes from airport operations reflected quickly so that my itinerary shows the correct departure gate.

userStoryName: Display boarding group and boarding status
userStoryDescription: As a passenger, I want boarding group and current boarding status displayed so that I know when to approach the gate.
As a passenger, I want a final-call alert when boarding is closing so that I have an opportunity to reach the gate.
As a support agent, I want to find bookings using confirmation, customer, or flight information so that I can quickly locate a travel case.
As a support agent, I want payment, refund, disruption, and baggage history in one view so that I can understand the customer's issue.
As an authorized support agent, I want permitted rebooking and refund actions with audit history so that customer issues can be resolved safely.
As a customer, I want destination suggestions based on saved preferences so that I can discover relevant trips.
As a traveler, I want relevant baggage, seat, and airport service recommendations so that useful options are easier to discover.
As a customer, I want recommendation personalization to honor my privacy choices so that my preferences are respected.

userStoryName: Create fare alert for route and dates
userStoryDescription: As a customer, I want to save a route, date range, and target price so that the platform can monitor fares for me.
As a customer, I want the platform to identify significant price decreases so that I am alerted only when the change is useful.
As a customer, I want a notification when a monitored fare reaches my configured threshold so that I can decide whether to book.

userStoryName: Apply corporate travel policy during search
userStoryDescription: As a business traveler, I want preferred and out-of-policy options identified so that I can make policy-compliant booking choices.

userStoryName: Capture cost center and business purpose
userStoryDescription: As a business traveler, I want required accounting information stored with my booking so that expenses can be allocated correctly.
As a manager, I want out-of-policy travel requests routed for approval so that exceptions are controlled.
As an operations engineer, I want a correlation identifier across search, payment, and booking services so that failures can be diagnosed end to end.

userStoryName: Monitor payment and booking reliability metrics
userStoryDescription: As an operations engineer, I want dashboards for payment authorization, booking creation, retries, and latency so that degradation is detected quickly.
As an operations engineer, I want actionable alerts for elevated booking and payment failures so that production incidents can be investigated promptly.
